dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, convex narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and exhibit high bilateral symmetry with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Thin, low-contrast linear marks resembling superficial scratches are visible on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple faint, linear epidermal marks (scars or rake marks) localized on the lower dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge and a sharply defined, dark circular blowhole aperture.
